package fixture

// The escape hatch, used as intended: this is a display label, not a decision. A heuristic with no
// waiver gets deleted the first time it misfires, and a deleted gate protects nothing.
func roleLabel(role string) string {
	//arch:allow-inline-authz formatting a label for display, decides no access
	if role == "owner" {
		return "Owner"
	}
	return role
}
